prompt: did we really land on the moon?
response: Yes, humans did indeed land on the Moon. This historic event occurred during the Apollo 11 mission on July 20, 1969. Astronauts Neil Armstrong and Buzz Aldrin became the first humans to set foot on the lunar surface, while Michael Collins orbited above in the Command Module. This was confirmed by a wealth of evidence, including photographs, video footage, and the collection of lunar rocks and soil samples that were brought back to Earth and have been studied extensively by scientists around the world. Since then, there have been several other successful Moon landings as part of the Apollo program.
